body.heading: Small counts as real
paragraphs: A four-line poem, a doodle in a margin, a photo of one interesting shadow. Making something small every day still counts as making, and it is much easier to protect than a grand weekly project.
The size is the point. When the bar is low, you start more often, and starting is where most creative work actually happens.

body.heading: Give it a home and a moment
paragraphs: Keep one notebook, folder or phone album just for these small things, and attach the habit to a moment that already exists: after breakfast, on the bus, while the kettle boils.
Some days the thing will be forgettable. That is fine. You are collecting evidence that you are a person who makes things, and occasionally the small thing surprises you.

takeaway: Make it tiny, make it daily, and let the collection grow on its own.
